only_in_closed_run: a reviewed expectation whose source pin does NOT match the library is ignored (no silent normalisation)
a reviewed expectation with a MATCHING source pin yields REVIEWED_CHANGE (neither PASS nor FAIL); a non-matching value is still FAIL/REVIEW_REQUIRED
guard demos and controls never rescue or fail a library check by themselves
only_in_r2_run: LIBRARY_ENFORCED: match=PASS, mismatch=FAIL; tuple and list are the same kind
a NOT-A-REVIEW entry applies as REVIEWED_CHANGE but is flagged (a dry run can never be a green run)
a reviewed entry (JSON form) matches the live tuple/int-key observation -> REVIEWED_CHANGE; a counterexample of any kind does not
a reviewed entry whose source pin does NOT match the library is ignored (no silent normalisation)
guard demos and harness controls are NEVER rescued or failed by a profile (even with a matching reviewed entry)
types are preserved: bool!=int, int!=float, str!=int, None!=False, order and length matter, [] != {} != None
unsupported / non-finite values are an ERROR on either side, never stringified
the changed live observations really have the H-1 shape (tuples inside a dict), and the written file round-trips through the strict loader
the same entries with a NON-matching source pin are ignored: FAIL again
with the disk profile whose pin matches: every changed check is REVIEWED_CHANGE (case PASS_WITH_REVIEWED_CHANGES), flagged as a self-test entry
without a profile the changed HOLD observation FAILs (never PASS, never adopted)
only the two valid profiles are accepted; every unsafe variant is rejected
